actions.reader_question: What should I use instead of Stripe for accepting card payments? [verb-only — no PAA, no completions]
actions.answer: Square, Helcim, Authorize.net, Shopify Payments, Paddle and Clover are six Stripe alternatives, and most of them publish the same 2.9% + 30¢ online card rate that Stripe does.
